name: Observe Terminal Vessel Test Run
description: Observe test execution for terminal vessel, capturing state before/after and test results

prompt.template:
Capture state before running tests:
1. Run: git status --porcelain > /tmp/terminal-git-before.txt
2. Run: find repos/terminal/src -type f -name '*.ts' -exec wc -l {} + > /tmp/terminal-loc-before.txt
3. Run: bun run typecheck 2>&1 | tee /tmp/terminal-typecheck-before.txt

tasks.description: Execute test suite and capture all output

prompt.template:
Run tests and capture results:
1. cd repos/terminal
2. Run: bun test --coverage 2>&1 | tee /tmp/terminal-test-output.txt
3. Capture exit code: echo $? > /tmp/terminal-test-exitcode.txt
4. Run: bun run typecheck 2>&1 | tee /tmp/terminal-typecheck.txt

Analyze test results:
1. Run: grep -E '(pass|fail)' /tmp/terminal-test-output.txt | tail -1 > /tmp/terminal-test-summary.txt
2. Count failures: grep -c 'fail' /tmp/terminal-test-output.txt > /tmp/terminal-fail-count.txt || echo 0 > /tmp/terminal-fail-count.txt
3. Extract duration: grep -oP '\[\K[0-9.]+(?=ms\])' /tmp/terminal-test-output.txt | tail -1 > /tmp/terminal-duration.txt

tasks.description: Package results as impulse for future activities

prompt.template:
Create impulse from test results:
1. Read summary: cat /tmp/terminal-test-summary.txt
2. Read exit code: cat /tmp/terminal-test-exitcode.txt
3. If exit code = 0, report success with duration
4. If exit code != 0, report failure with error details
